name: vibe-visual-forge
description: Cross-platform HTTPS MCP tools, installable responsive PWA UI studio, 3D GLB blockouts, local optional desktop executor.

interface.longDescription: Cross-platform PWA for mobile and desktop: working HTML UI exports, low-poly GLB scenes, UI/3D tool calls and bounded quality checks. Cloud MCP requires deployment and connection; background AI jobs and photorealism are not included.
defaultPrompt: Create a production UI from my screenshots, render it and compare visual fidelity.
Create a game-ready 3D environment with materials, LOD and scene QA.
Inspect my project, find visual defects and fix them rather than showing a mockup.
